references.title: Restrict access to Application Load Balancers
references.quote: Configure the Application Load Balancer to only forward requests that contain the custom HTTP header.
references.supports: Bước ALB chỉ forward request có custom header (C), đi cùng bước CloudFront thêm header (B).

references.title: Restrict access to Application Load Balancers
references.section: Configure CloudFront to add a custom HTTP header to requests
references.quote: You can configure CloudFront to add a custom HTTP header to the requests that it sends to your origin (in this case, an Application Load Balancer).
references.supports: CloudFront thêm custom header vào origin request (B).

references.title: Control the cache key with a policy
references.section: Control the cache key with a policy
references.quote: With a CloudFront cache policy, you can specify the HTTP headers, cookies, and query strings that CloudFront includes in the cache key
references.supports: Cache policy chỉ chọn giá trị đưa vào cache key, không thêm header bí mật (A).

references.title: HTTP headers and Application Load Balancers
references.quote: By default, the Application Load Balancer stores the IP address of the client in the X-Forwarded-For request header and passes the header to your server.
references.supports: X-Forwarded-For mang IP client, không phải dấu hiệu request đến từ CloudFront (D).

references.title: Requirements for using SSL/TLS certificates with CloudFront
references.quote: To use an ACM certificate with a CloudFront distribution, make sure you request (or import) the certificate in the US East (N. Virginia) Region (us-east-1).
references.supports: Certificate chỉ phục vụ HTTPS; không có cơ chế giới hạn nguồn request (E).

references.title: Control origin requests with a policy
references.quote: HTTP headers, and cookies that you include in the cache key (using a cache policy) are automatically included in origin requests.
references.supports: Header trong cache policy là header của viewer được chuyển tiếp sang origin; giá trị do client gửi nên không chứng minh request đi qua CloudFront (A).

references.title: Restrict access to Application Load Balancers
references.quote: After you complete these steps, users can only access your Application Load Balancer through CloudFront.
references.supports: Hai bước custom header (B) + ALB chỉ forward khi có header (C) đạt đúng yêu cầu chỉ nhận traffic từ CloudFront.
